title: The Home Road
subtitle: Paid in whole levels
description: The gate, from the far side, looks exactly as it did from the near
side, which the expedition agrees not to discuss.
Its payout is experience in whole levels: `amount: 3` with
`levels: true` -- three levels, not three points, which is the
difference between pocket money and a wage. Experience rewards are
submit tasks everywhere in this collection: the press is the
consent, and the press takes it.
